title: How to prepare your home for showings: a seller checklist
excerpt: A practical, room-by-room checklist to help your Niagara home show beautifully and sell for top dollar.
content:
First impressions sell homes. Most buyers decide how they feel about a property within minutes of walking in, so a little preparation can make a big difference to your sale price and how quickly you get offers.

Start with curb appeal

  • Cut the lawn, trim hedges and weed garden beds
  • Sweep walkways and clear clutter from the porch
  • Make sure the front door, house numbers and lighting look fresh

Declutter and depersonalize

Buyers need to picture themselves living in the space. Pack away family photos, collections and extra furniture. Clear countertops and closets are a quiet signal that the home has plenty of storage.

Clean like never before

A deep clean is the cheapest upgrade you can make. Pay special attention to kitchens, bathrooms, windows, baseboards and light fixtures.

Fix the small things

  • Leaky taps, loose handles and squeaky doors
  • Burnt-out bulbs and scuffed walls
  • Cracked tiles or caulking around tubs and sinks

Neutralize and brighten

Fresh paint in light, neutral tones makes rooms feel bigger and brighter. Open blinds and turn on every light before showings.

On showing day

  • Make beds, empty garbage bins and tidy up quickly
  • Set the temperature to comfortable
  • Take pets with you and store valuables and medications securely
